lastText: STAVKASVODKAHome19141915191619171918HARD MODE — EROSION 4/4-8MANPOWER-4MUNITIONS-6HOME STABILITYIV.1917The Command Is ReorganisedNo single order did this. There is a record covering three years in which this headquarters attached the throne to each successive military outcome, and then another authority arrived that had watched it happen. A command that spent the regime's standing to buy operations is not a command the successor regime keeps.Contested judgmentThe staff is dispersed to other duties. The war continues without them and does not go better.Return to file
